samples.title: Lớp học trực tuyến
samples.prompt: Consider the proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons. What are its advantages and disadvantages?
requirementsVi: Bàn cả lợi ích và bất lợi.
Mỗi mặt cần giải thích và ví dụ.
Tổng hợp, không tự đổi thành chỉ nêu ý kiến.
samples.summaryVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that universities should offer online classes alongside classroom lessons could affect everyday life in several ways. It is useful to consider both the opportunities it creates and the difficulties it may bring. Neither side should be judged only from a slogan, because the practical details can make a substantial difference.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu nhiệm vụ so sánh hai mặt.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities. This is possible because recorded lessons can be watched again at a convenient time. For example, a student who works in a restaurant can review a morning lecture after the evening shift. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Học online giúp linh hoạt giờ học; cần thảo luận và hỗ trợ để tránh học một mình.

paragraphs.label: Bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that some learners may feel isolated. This matters because a screen does not always make it easy to ask a quick question or form friendships. For instance, a first-year student may stop working on a difficult task instead of asking a classmate for help. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân tích bất lợi bằng tình huống cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Điều gì làm thay đổi tác động?
paragraphs.text: The balance between these effects depends partly on organisation. For example, courses sometimes provide recordings without enough opportunities for discussion. A way to reduce this difficulty would be to schedule small weekly discussion groups. A teacher could meet six students at a time and ask each person to explain one difficult point. This would not remove every disadvantage, but it could make the approach more suitable for a wider range of people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích yếu tố làm lợi–hại thay đổi, không phủ nhận bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, an important advantage is that students can fit learning around work and family responsibilities, whereas a notable disadvantage is that some learners may feel isolated. Both should be considered before a decision is made, with attention to the resources and circumstances of the people affected.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt đúng hai mặt đã phân tích.

paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that students might choose too early with limited information. For instance, a young person may enrol in a hospitality course without realising that some jobs involve evening shifts. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân tích bất lợi bằng tình huống cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Điều gì làm thay đổi tác động?
paragraphs.text: The balance between these effects depends partly on organisation. For example, career advice sometimes focuses on prestige instead of the details of each route. A way to reduce this difficulty would be to provide course visits and balanced guidance about work and further study. Schools could invite former students from several training routes to discuss both the benefits and difficulties. This would not remove every disadvantage, but it could make the approach more suitable for a wider range of people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích yếu tố làm lợi–hại thay đổi, không phủ nhận bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, an important advantage is that students can discover routes that match practical interests, whereas a notable disadvantage is that students might choose too early with limited information. Both should be considered before a decision is made, with attention to the resources and circumstances of the people affected.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt đúng hai mặt đã phân tích.

samples.title: Học suốt đời
samples.focus: learning new skills as an adult
samples.prompt: Consider the proposal that communities should provide more affordable classes for adults. What are its advantages and disadvantages?

samples.summaryVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

paragraphs.label: Mở bài
paragraphs.text: The proposal that communities should provide more affordable classes for adults could affect everyday life in several ways. It is useful to consider both the opportunities it creates and the difficulties it may bring. Neither side should be judged only from a slogan, because the practical details can make a substantial difference.
paragraphs.noteVi: Nêu nhiệm vụ so sánh hai mặt.

paragraphs.label: Lợi ích
paragraphs.text: One important point in favour of the proposal is that adults can update skills without returning to full-time study. This is possible because short local courses can fit around work and caring responsibilities. For example, a shop assistant can attend an evening computer class to learn how to manage simple spreadsheets. The value of this example is that the benefit is connected with a real everyday need. It is easier for people to see the purpose of an approach when they can relate it to their own situation.
paragraphs.noteVi: Lớp học cho người lớn cần vừa túi tiền và phù hợp giờ làm, đi lại, chăm con.

paragraphs.label: Bất lợi
paragraphs.text: A difficulty that should not be ignored is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. This matters because transport, childcare and changing work hours can create barriers. For instance, a parent may miss an evening class because there is no one available to look after a child. The result may be frustration or a decision to stop taking part. This is not simply a question of people refusing to make an effort; practical conditions can prevent a reasonable idea from working as intended.
paragraphs.noteVi: Phân tích bất lợi bằng tình huống cụ thể.

paragraphs.label: Điều gì làm thay đổi tác động?
paragraphs.text: The balance between these effects depends partly on organisation. For example, course providers may focus on fees while overlooking practical access. A way to reduce this difficulty would be to offer flexible schedules and simple support for attendance. A centre could repeat the same lesson at two different times and provide materials for missed sessions. This would not remove every disadvantage, but it could make the approach more suitable for a wider range of people.
paragraphs.noteVi: Giải thích yếu tố làm lợi–hại thay đổi, không phủ nhận bất lợi.

paragraphs.label: Kết bài
paragraphs.text: In conclusion, an important advantage is that adults can update skills without returning to full-time study, whereas a notable disadvantage is that people with the greatest need may still be unable to attend. Both should be considered before a decision is made, with attention to the resources and circumstances of the people affected.
paragraphs.noteVi: Tóm tắt đúng hai mặt đã phân tích.
